epics.name: Image Upload & Organization
epics.description: Enables users to securely upload images to the AltifyAI platform, view their uploaded assets, and manage them for alt text generation.

stories.i_want_to: upload a single image from my computer
stories.so_that: I can quickly generate alt text for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the upload page, When I select an image file and click 'Upload', Then the image appears in my dashboard as 'Processing'.
Given I upload an unsupported file type (e.g., .doc), When I click 'Upload', Then I see an error message indicating invalid file type.
Given an image is uploaded, When I view my dashboard, Then I see a thumbnail of the image with its filename.

stories.i_want_to: upload multiple images in a batch
stories.so_that: I can efficiently process a large number of assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the upload page, When I drag and drop multiple image files, Then all selected images appear in my dashboard as 'Processing'.
Given I upload a batch of images, When the upload is complete, Then I receive a notification that the batch upload was successful.
Given a batch upload fails for one image, When the upload completes, Then I am informed which images failed and which succeeded.

stories.i_want_to: view a list of all my uploaded images
stories.so_that: I can keep track of my assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I navigate to my image library, Then I see a paginated list of all images I have uploaded.
Given I have many images, When I view the image list, Then each image displays a thumbnail, filename, and upload date.
Given I have no images uploaded, When I view my image library, Then I see a message prompting me to upload images.

stories.i_want_to: delete an image from my library
stories.so_that: I can manage my storage and remove unwanted assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing an image in my library, When I click the 'Delete' icon, Then a confirmation dialog appears.
Given I confirm the deletion, When the image is deleted, Then it no longer appears in my image library.
Given an image is deleted, When I try to access its alt text generation history, Then it is no longer available.

epics.name: AI Alt Text Generation
epics.description: The core functionality for AltifyAI, enabling the automatic generation of descriptive and SEO-friendly alt text using advanced AI models.

stories.i_want_to: automatically generate alt text for an uploaded image
stories.so_that: I don't have to write it manually.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image has been uploaded, When I select the image and click 'Generate Alt Text', Then the system starts processing the image.
Given the alt text is generated, When I view the image details, Then I see the AI-generated alt text displayed.
Given the generation fails, When I view the image details, Then I see an error message and an option to retry.

stories.i_want_to: generate alt text for multiple selected images at once
stories.so_that: I can process images in bulk.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have selected multiple images in my library, When I click 'Generate Alt Text for Selected', Then the system processes all selected images in the background.
Given the batch generation is complete, When I view the image library, Then each processed image shows its generated alt text.
Given some images fail in a batch, When the batch completes, Then I receive a summary of successful and failed generations.

stories.i_want_to: provide specific keywords or context for alt text generation
stories.so_that: the output is highly relevant to my products.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am about to generate alt text for an image, When I enter keywords (e.g., 'red running shoes, Nike, athletic') in a dedicated input field, Then the AI uses these keywords to influence the generated alt text.
Given I provide keywords, When the alt text is generated, Then the output includes or is heavily influenced by the provided keywords.
Given I provide a short description, When the alt text is generated, Then the output incorporates the provided description into the alt text.

stories.i_want_to: see the generated alt text clearly displayed next to its corresponding image
stories.so_that: I can easily review it.
acceptance_criteria: Given alt text has been generated for an image, When I click on the image in my library, Then a detail view opens showing the image and its generated alt text.
Given I am in the detail view, When I scroll through my images, Then the alt text updates dynamically for each image.
Given the alt text is long, When I view it, Then it is displayed in a resizable text area.

epics.name: Review & Editing Workflow
epics.description: Provides tools for users to review, edit, and approve the AI-generated alt text, ensuring accuracy, brand voice, and compliance.

stories.i_want_to: easily edit the AI-generated alt text
stories.so_that: I can refine it to my specific needs or brand voice.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing the generated alt text for an image, When I click an 'Edit' button, Then the alt text becomes editable in a text field.
Given I have made changes, When I click 'Save', Then my edited alt text is stored and displayed.
Given I edit the alt text, When I navigate away without saving, Then I am prompted to save or discard changes.

stories.i_want_to: mark alt text as 'Approved' or 'Needs Review'
stories.so_that: I can track the status of my image optimizations.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have reviewed alt text for an image, When I click an 'Approve' button, Then the alt text status changes to 'Approved'.
Given I want to flag alt text for further review, When I click a 'Needs Review' button, Then the alt text status changes to 'Needs Review'.
Given an alt text is approved, When I view the image in the library, Then a visual indicator (e.g., a checkmark) shows its approved status.

stories.i_want_to: see suggestions for improving alt text (e.g., keyword density, length)
stories.so_that: I can optimize it further.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am editing alt text, When the system detects potential improvements (e.g., missing keywords, too short), Then it displays suggestions (e.g., 'Consider adding 'product name'').
Given a suggestion is provided, When I click on it, Then it offers to automatically apply or guide me on how to implement it.
Given the alt text is optimized, When I review it, Then the suggestions are no longer displayed.

epics.name: Export & Integration
epics.description: Provides mechanisms for users to retrieve and utilize their finalized alt text in their respective content management systems or websites.

stories.i_want_to: easily copy the generated alt text to my clipboard
stories.so_that: I can paste it directly into my content editor.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing the alt text for an image, When I click a 'Copy' button, Then the alt text is copied to my clipboard.
Given the alt text is copied, When I paste into a text editor, Then the exact alt text appears.
Given the copy operation is successful, When I click 'Copy', Then I see a temporary confirmation message (e.g., 'Copied!').

stories.i_want_to: export alt text for multiple images as a CSV file
stories.so_that: I can bulk upload it to my CMS.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have selected multiple images with approved alt text, When I click 'Export CSV', Then a CSV file containing image filenames and their alt text is downloaded.
Given the CSV is downloaded, When I open it, Then it contains columns for 'Filename', 'Original Alt Text (if any)', 'Generated Alt Text', and 'Approved Alt Text'.
Given I export a large number of images, When the export completes, Then the CSV file is correctly formatted and contains all selected data.

stories.i_want_to: generate a JSON file containing image URLs and their alt text
stories.so_that: I can integrate it with my product catalog system.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have selected multiple images with approved alt text, When I click 'Export JSON', Then a JSON file containing image URLs and their alt text is downloaded.
Given the JSON is downloaded, When I open it, Then it contains an array of objects, each with 'imageUrl' and 'altText' keys.
Given I export a large number of images, When the export completes, Then the JSON file is correctly formatted and contains all selected data.

epics.name: User Account & Billing
epics.description: Manages user authentication, profile information, and basic subscription/usage tracking.

stories.i_want_to: register for an AltifyAI account
stories.so_that: I can start using the service.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the registration page, When I provide a valid email and password and click 'Sign Up', Then my account is created and I am logged in.
Given I provide an email that is already registered, When I click 'Sign Up', Then I receive an error message indicating the email is taken.
Given my account is created, When I log in, Then I am directed to my dashboard.

stories.i_want_to: log in to my AltifyAI account
stories.so_that: I can access my images and generated alt text.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the login page, When I enter my registered email and password and click 'Log In', Then I am successfully authenticated and redirected to my dashboard.
Given I enter incorrect credentials, When I click 'Log In', Then I receive an error message indicating invalid credentials.
Given I am logged in, When I close and reopen my browser, Then I remain logged in (session persistence).

stories.i_want_to: view my current usage (e.g., images processed)
stories.so_that: I can monitor my subscription limits.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I navigate to my 'Account Settings' or 'Dashboard', Then I see a clear display of my current image processing count.
Given I am approaching a limit, When I view my usage, Then I see a warning or indicator that I am near my limit.
Given my usage is displayed, When I process more images, Then the usage count updates accordingly.

stories.i_want_to: update my account password
stories.so_that: I can maintain security.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am in my account settings, When I navigate to the password change section, Then I can enter my current password, new password, and confirm new password.
Given I enter valid passwords, When I click 'Update Password', Then my password is changed successfully.
Given I enter an incorrect current password, When I click 'Update Password', Then I receive an error message.

personas.name: Niche Content Solopreneur
personas.description: An individual managing their own niche blog, online store, or service business. They need to create high-quality, targeted content efficiently without hiring a team.

personas.name: Small Business Niche Marketer
personas.description: A marketing professional or business owner focusing on driving traffic and engagement for a small business targeting a specific niche. They need diverse content types that resonate with their audience and align with their brand.

personas.name: Growth-Focused Agency Consultant
personas.description: A consultant working for an agency that serves multiple clients across various niches. They require scalable content solutions, the ability to manage diverse projects, and tools to ensure brand consistency.

epics.name: Niche Profile & Setup
epics.description: Enables users to define their specific niche, target audience, and content goals, allowing the AI to generate highly relevant and personalized content.

stories.i_want_to: define my primary niche and target audience
stories.so_that: the AI understands my content context
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the niche setup page, When I input my niche (e.g., 'Sustainable Urban Gardening') and target audience (e.g., 'Eco-conscious city dwellers aged 25-45'), Then the system saves this profile.
Given a niche profile is saved, When I generate new content, Then the AI output reflects the defined niche and audience.

stories.i_want_to: specify my brand's tone of voice and key messaging
stories.so_that: generated content aligns with my brand identity
acceptance_criteria: Given I have defined a niche, When I select from predefined tone options (e.g., 'Informative,' 'Playful,' 'Professional') or provide custom tone examples, Then the system applies this tone to future content generation.
Given a tone is set, When I generate content, Then the AI output demonstrates the selected tone.

stories.i_want_to: create multiple niche profiles for different clients
stories.so_that: I can manage diverse content strategies within one account
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I navigate to the 'Niche Profiles' section, Then I can create a new profile with a unique name (e.g., 'Client A - Vegan Pet Food').
Given multiple profiles exist, When I switch between profiles, Then the content generation interface reflects the selected profile's settings.

epics.name: AI Content Generation Core
epics.description: Provides the primary functionality for users to generate various types of niche-specific content using AI.

stories.i_want_to: generate a blog post outline based on a topic
stories.so_that: I have a structured starting point for my content
acceptance_criteria: Given I have selected a niche profile, When I input a topic (e.g., 'Benefits of Composting in Small Apartments'), Then the AI generates a multi-section outline with headings and sub-points.
Given an outline is generated, When I review it, Then I can proceed to full content generation or modify the outline.

stories.i_want_to: generate social media captions for a specific product or event
stories.so_that: I can quickly create engaging posts
acceptance_criteria: Given I have selected a niche profile, When I provide product details (e.g., 'New organic dog treats') and target platform (e.g., 'Instagram'), Then the AI generates 3-5 distinct caption options.
Given captions are generated, When I select one, Then I can copy it to my clipboard.

stories.i_want_to: generate multiple variations of a content piece (e.g., blog intro)
stories.so_that: I can offer diverse options to my clients
acceptance_criteria: Given I have provided a prompt for a content section, When I request 'more variations', Then the AI generates 2-3 alternative versions of the text.
Given variations are generated, When I compare them, Then I can select the best fit or request further iterations.

stories.i_want_to: generate a full blog post draft from an outline
stories.so_that: I can quickly produce long-form content
acceptance_criteria: Given I have an approved outline, When I click 'Generate Full Content', Then the AI populates the outline with detailed paragraphs for each section.
Given a full draft is generated, When I review it, Then the content is coherent and follows the specified niche and tone.

epics.name: Content Editing & Refinement
epics.description: Enables users to review, edit, and optimize AI-generated content to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with their brand voice.

stories.i_want_to: manually edit any generated content directly within the platform
stories.so_that: I can fine-tune it to my exact needs
acceptance_criteria: Given I have generated content, When I click on the text area, Then I can freely type, delete, and modify the content.
Given I have made edits, When I save the content, Then my changes are preserved.

stories.i_want_to: check the generated content for originality/plagiarism
stories.so_that: I can ensure unique content for my brand
acceptance_criteria: Given I have generated content, When I click 'Check Originality', Then the system scans the content against public sources.
Given the scan is complete, When I view the results, Then I see a percentage of originality and highlighted sections if matches are found.

stories.i_want_to: request specific revisions to generated content (e.g., 'make it more formal', 'shorten this paragraph')
stories.so_that: I can guide the AI to better meet client requirements
acceptance_criteria: Given I have generated content, When I highlight a section and provide a textual instruction (e.g., 'Rephrase this to be more concise'), Then the AI modifies the highlighted section accordingly.
Given a revision is made, When I review it, Then the change reflects my instruction.

stories.i_want_to: get suggestions for improving SEO for my content
stories.so_that: it ranks better in search engines
acceptance_criteria: Given I have a generated blog post, When I click 'SEO Suggestions', Then the system provides recommendations for keywords, readability, and meta descriptions.
Given suggestions are provided, When I implement them, Then the content quality score updates.

epics.name: Content Management & Export
epics.description: Allows users to save, organize, and export their generated content for use on various platforms.

stories.i_want_to: save my generated content as a draft
stories.so_that: I can return to it later for further editing
acceptance_criteria: Given I have generated content, When I click 'Save Draft', Then the content is stored under my account.
Given content is saved, When I navigate to my 'Saved Content' dashboard, Then I see the draft listed with its title and last modified date.

stories.i_want_to: organize my saved content into projects or folders
stories.so_that: I can easily manage content for different campaigns
acceptance_criteria: Given I have saved content, When I create a new 'Project' (e.g., 'Summer Sale Campaign'), Then I can assign saved content pieces to that project.
Given content is assigned, When I filter by project, Then only content belonging to that project is displayed.

stories.i_want_to: export generated content in common formats (e.g., .docx, .txt, HTML)
stories.so_that: I can deliver it to clients or upload it to other platforms
acceptance_criteria: Given I have finalized content, When I select an export option (e.g., 'Export as .docx'), Then the system downloads the content in the chosen format.
Given the file is downloaded, When I open it, Then the formatting (headings, paragraphs) is preserved.

stories.i_want_to: copy the generated content to my clipboard with one click
stories.so_that: I can quickly paste it into my CMS or social media platform
acceptance_criteria: Given I have generated content, When I click the 'Copy to Clipboard' button, Then the entire content is copied.
Given content is copied, When I paste it into an external text editor, Then the text appears as expected.
